title: Ali ko zakhme sar
body:
ali ko zaqme sar tadpa raha hai
musalla khoon mein dooba ja raha hai
<<DIVIDER>>
namazi saath hai chadar sambhale
nabi ka janasheen yun jaa raha hai
ali ko zaqme sar...
<<DIVIDER>>
hui thi kaabe mein jiski wiladat
wo masjid mein shahadat pa raha hai
ali ko zaqme sar...
<<DIVIDER>>
batati hai ruqe hyder pe zardi
lahoo mein zehr milta ja raha hai
ali ko zaqme sar...
<<DIVIDER>>
saware doshe ahmed ko to dekho
lahoo mein doob kar ghar ja raha hai
ali ko zaqme sar...
<<DIVIDER>>
hassan ko de ke meeras e payambar
nabi ka jaanasheen farma raha hai
ali ko zaqme sar...
<<DIVIDER>>
khabar rakhna hassan sab bhaiyo ki
tumhe jo kuch hai saumpe ja raha hai
ali ko zaqme sar...
<<DIVIDER>>
mera abbas to hai sab se kamsin
jo ro kar aur dil tadpa raha hai
ali ko zaqme sar...
<<DIVIDER>>
hussain usko galay se tum lagana
tumhare simt de ke aa raha hai
ali ko zaqme sar...
<<DIVIDER>>
khayale karbala aa aa ke shayad
ali ke qalb ko tadpa raha hai
ali ko zaqme sar...
<<DIVIDER>>
do aalam ka yehi mushkil kusha hai
jo beton ke sahare ja raha hai
ali ko zaqme sar...
<<DIVIDER>>
bine muljim teri talwaar ka waar
kalaam allah se takra raha hai
ali ko zaqme sar...
<<DIVIDER>>
ali ko fazl manzar karbala ka
tasavvur mein sab aa raha hai
ali ko zaqme sar...
author: Fazl Lakhnavi
